subject.title: fix(agents): idle-timeout stalled provider response body reads

question: Should a 30-second post-header idle timeout be a universal contract of the shared provider readers, or should timeout ownership remain with individual provider operations that can account for their latency semantics?
rationale: The code is mechanically sound for a stalled stream, but the correct compatibility boundary determines whether valid existing provider responses can now fail and cannot be inferred from this narrow PR alone.

options.title: Use operation-specific deadlines
options.body: Keep the shared readers behavior-neutral and add idle limits only at callers whose response contract has a defined bounded streaming interval.

options.title: Adopt a shared reader contract
options.body: Accept the universal 30-second idle policy only after documenting the contract, auditing callers, and adding compatibility coverage for affected provider operations.

recommendation.title: Use operation-specific deadlines
recommendation.body: Keep the shared readers behavior-neutral and add idle limits only at callers whose response contract has a defined bounded streaming interval.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership could not be established from the supplied evidence; an agents-area owner should make the compatibility decision.
